messages:
Maya: Quick design sync — deciding where invoice download/entry CTA should live in org vs project views. I posted a mock: https://placeholder.mock/img — looking for quick takes on discoverability vs noise. Sam: For me project view = inline invoice action per row (fast access). Org view = single 'Download org invoice' in header. :thinking_face: Liam: Inline CTAs add visual noise in dense lists. Could we hide it in an overflow menu on the row? keeps the list clean. Maya: Overflow menu reduces discoverability. FYI data: ~63% of org users start from org level, and ~80% of downloads come from first 3 rows — discoverability matters. Dana: How about a compact icon button (download icon) that only appears on hover and is keyboard-focusable? preserves space but still discoverable for keyboard users. Oliver: If we do hover-only, be careful with keyboard focus. Need explicit aria-labels so screen readers read: 'Download invoice for Project Foo'. Example: ``` ``` Sam: Copy nit: 'Download invoice' vs 'Download PDF' — I vote for explicit 'Download PDF' since that's what users expect. Maya: Agreed. Also token breakdown: should each row show expanded tokens by default or be collapsed behind 'View tokens'? Expanded = transparency, collapsed = less noise. Thoughts? Liam: Default collapsed with a 1-line summary (sparkline + totals) seems sensible. Then an expand panel reveals itemized tokens and price. e.g. '3.4k tokens • $12.34' + sparkline, expandable. Dana: Accessibility: expansion must be keyboard operable and announced. Use aria-expanded + role=region and update aria-hidden. Example: ```
…
``` Maya: On mobile we can't show sparklines for every row. For narrow widths show a compact pill with summary and a chevron to open details. Oliver: Visual hierarchy note: make org/project toggle persistent in top-left so scope is always visible. If user is deep in a project page, show a small in-row breadcrumb 'Project: X' to avoid losing context. Sam: One more copy nit: the label 'Scope' confuses people. Suggest we use 'Organization / Project' or 'Account / Project' depending on language. Maya: Action items: 1) Sam — prototype inline overflow menu with compact download icon + aria-labels. 2) Dana — write a11y spec for expandable token panel + keyboard flows. 3) Liam — prototype collapsed token row with sparkline + expand behavior. 4) Maya — update copy strings to 'Download PDF' and replace 'Scope' with 'Organization / Project'. Due: EOD Thu. Sam: Question — should invoice rows be sorted by invoice date desc by default? Analytics show most users want most recent first. Liam: Yes, default to most recent first. Maya: Great — thanks all! :heart: Oliver: Quick followup: I'll add hover states for the download icon and test contrast ratios against our color tokens — noted accessibility contrast requirement 3:1 for icons on hover. Dana: Also add keyboard shortcut note for power users (e.g., focus + D to download focused invoice) — we'll validate with accessibility team. Maya: Perfect. Closing this thread after PRs land.
